edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged role.
owner state variable is written from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transfer.
Claimable.transferOwnership guarded by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
claimOwnership guarded by onlyPendingOwner using msg.sender.
pendingOwner is compared against msg.sender for authorization.
modules[msg.sender] is the authorization source for module checks.
fallback dispatcher resolves msg.sig into methodToModule.
Wallet fallback authorization depends on msg.sender being a module.
transact is restricted by onlyFromFactoryOrModule using msg.sender.
addModule checks msg.sender against modules mapping or factory.
removeModule restricted to modules via msg.sender.
setOwner restricted to modules via msg.sender.
initOwner restricted to the wallet factory via msg.sender.
setLock records lockedBy = msg.sender, tying lock to a module.
onlyWalletModule requires Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender).
currentQuota selects quota based on block.timestamp versus pendingUntil.
spentQuota decays spending based on block.timestamp.
addToSpent stores spentTimestamp from block.timestamp.
isGuardianActive compares validSince to block.timestamp.
setLock requires lock > block.timestamp.
touchLastActive writes block.timestamp into lastActive.
setInheritor refreshes lastActive with block.timestamp.
addToWhitelist clamps effective time with block.timestamp.
isWhitelisted compares effectiveTime to block.timestamp.
isValidSignature returns early when wallet lock exceeds block.timestamp.
transact routes execution into the nonReentrantCall guard.
nonReentrantCall performs the low-level call/delegatecall/staticcall.
transact execution is protected by the nonReentrant modifier path.
nonReentrant modifier reads and writes _guardValue.
executeMetaTx performs the external call to metaTx.to.
Meta-tx validation runs after the external call, inverting checks-effects-interactions.
Gas reimbursement is executed after the meta-transaction call.
Wallet fallback forwards calldata and value to the bound module.
Proxy fallback delegatecalls to the implementation address.
setImplementation writes the slot read by the proxy fallback.
sendETH performs a low-level call with value to the recipient.
sendETHAndVerify delegates the transfer to sendETH.
reimburseGasFee transfers value through the ETH/token transfer helpers.
isValidSignature verifies contract signers via ERC1271 staticcall.
isValidSignature verifies EOA signers via ECDSA recovery.
register requires verifyApproval before touching ENS state.
verifyApproval recovers the signer via ecrecover and checks manager status.
createWallet validates the signed request before deploying.
createWallet deploys the proxy with CREATE2 using owner and salt.
verifyAndUpdate marks hashes[wallet][hash] as consumed.
verifyAndUpdate advances nonces[wallet].
verifyAndUpdate requires isNonceValid before accepting a nonce.
isNonceValid reads nonces[wallet] for ordering checks.
addGuardian writes guardian data into wallets[wallet].
removeGuardian writes the guardian validUntil window.
changeQuota downcasts newQuota to uint128.
addToSpent downcasts the summed spent quota to uint128.
checkAndAddToSpent relies on spentQuota arithmetic to enforce limits.
changeDefaultQuota writes the defaultQuota state variable.
newOwner parameter is written to owner after onlyOwner check.
newOwner parameter becomes pendingOwner, awaiting claim.
wallet parameter scopes the quota change under onlyWalletModule.
amount parameter is added into the wallet's spent quota.
nonce parameter is validated and persisted as replay protection.
hash parameter is stored to prevent duplicate signed requests.
metaTx struct fields drive the external call and reimbursement.
signature parameter is verified during meta-tx validation.
to parameter is the recipient of the low-level value call.
amount parameter is the value forwarded in the low-level call.
signHash parameter is passed to ecrecover.
signature bytes are decoded into r, s, v for ecrecover.
_initialOwner parameter becomes the wallet owner.
addr parameter is whitelisted for the wallet.
effectiveTime parameter controls whitelist activation timing.
_signature is verified against the wallet owner.
gasUsed local is computed and charged back to the wallet.
success local reflects the outcome of the guarded low-level call.
External call to attacker-influenced metaTx.to can re-enter executeMetaTx before validation and nonce update.
Fallback call into a module executes external code that may re-enter the wallet.
addModule calls Module(_module).activate(), allowing re-entry into the wallet.
removeModule calls Module(_module).deactivate() before deleting the module.
Module callbacks can re-enter transact from within the same execution context.
Reimbursement performs a token/ETH transfer that can call back into the wallet.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner parameter only exists to feed Ownable.transferOwnership ownership assignment.
newOwner parameter only exists to feed Claimable.transferOwnership pendingOwner assignment.
wallet parameter is only meaningful as the scoping key of changeQuota under onlyWalletModule.
amount parameter is only used to increase the wallet's spent quota in addToSpent.
nonce parameter is only used by NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate for replay protection.
hash parameter is only used by HashStore.verifyAndUpdate for replay protection.
metaTx calldata parameter shapes the destination, gas and call data of executeMetaTx.
signature parameter is only consumed by the meta-tx validation routine.
to parameter is only used as the recipient of the low-level ETH transfer.
amount parameter is only used as the value of the low-level ETH transfer.
signHash parameter is only used to recover the signer.
signature parameter is only decoded and passed to ecrecover.
_initialOwner parameter is only used to set the wallet owner during init.
addr parameter is only used to add the address to the whitelist set.
effectiveTime parameter is only used to schedule whitelist effectiveness.
gasUsed is a temporary accounting local inside executeMetaTx.
success is a temporary result local of the guarded low-level call.
_signature local is only used for owner signature verification in isValidSignature.
